title.narrative: ASEAN-Korea Cooperation for Methane Mitigation

description.narrative: To act as the lead implementing agency of a regional ASEAN cooperation program initiated by the Republic of Korea’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The program’s goal is to contribute to methane emission reductions in ASEAN countries by:1. Supporting the development of enabling policies and institutions2. Improving methane emissions measurement3. Designing, financing, and implementing methane emission reduction projects4. Promoting regional dialogue and partnership

To establish a strong foundation for the reduction of methane emissions at scale in the ASEAN region by (i) developing enabling policies and institutions, (ii) improving the measurement of methane emissions, (iii) designing, financing, and implementing methane emissions reduction projects, and (iv) promoting regional dialogue and partnership.

description.narrative: Two concept notes for scaled-up national-level interventions (per country) endorsed by their respective MRCs.Each concept note should describe an intervention with a budget of at least USD 5M to be considered large-scale.* Total no. of concept notes = 8 countries with MRCs (BN, KH, ID, LA, MY, PH, TH, VN) x 2 = 16.
